bias.en: Bearish · back above the Sep 3 low
bias.zh: 偏空 · 回到 9 月 3 日低点上方

read.en: ASML rose 0.5% on Oct 15 to $1,657.44 on above-average volume, after an intraday low of $1,594. It is below its 5-day ($1,711.2), 10-day ($1,769.2), rising 30-day ($1,730.3) and rising 100-day ($1,748.6) averages and 5% above the 200-day ($1,574.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and has now slipped below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,860.8), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 阿斯麦 10月15日在成交量高于平均的情况下上涨 0.5%，收于 $1,657.44，盘中低点为 $1,594。股价位于 5 日（$1,711.2）、10 日（$1,769.2）、上行的 30 日（$1,730.3）和上行的 100 日均线（$1,748.6）下方，比 200 日均线（$1,574.4）高 5%。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，现已跌至零轴之下；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$1,860.8），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The $1,619 Sep 3 low broke intraday, but the drop stopped above the $1,573–1,574 zone and the close recovered to $1,657. Resistance is $1,682 (Oct 13 low), then $1,711 (5-day average) and $1,730–1,749 (30 and 100-day averages). Support is $1,619, then $1,594 (Oct 15 low) and $1,573–1,574 (Sep 14 low, 200-day). A close above $1,682 would open $1,711.
